options.content:
# Humedat@ -- Isla San Francisco

Has entrado al visualizador web de **Humedat@, plataforma en tiempo real para el monitoreo de calidad de aguas** de humedales de Chile.

Humedat@ es una innovación tecnológica nacida en Valdivia, e impulsada por el [Centro de Humedales Río Cruces (CEHUM)](https://cehum.org/). 

Consiste en boyas de acero inox hechas con barriles cerveceros reutilizados, con múltiples sensores ambientales y electrónica de fuente abierta para la transmisión inalámbrica constante de datos desde diversos ecosistemas acuáticos hasta usuarios como tú. El aparato tiene tres conjuntos de sensores: 1) sensores acuáticos tales como T, pH, conductividad
eléctrica, oxígeno disuelto, y potencial de oxido-reducción; 2) sensores atmosféricos tales como temperatura y presión atmosférica; y 3) sensores internos que monitorean y resguardan el ambiente electrónico dentro del barril incluyendo estanqueidad, humedad del aire interno, temperatura, y estado de carga de baterías.

El desarrollo liderado por el [Dr. Cristián Correa](https://scholar.google.ca/citations?user=H3toP-0AAAAJ&hl=en) (cristiancorrea@gmail.com) ha contado con la colaboración del Laboratorio de Fabricación Digital [LeufüLab](https://leufulab.cl/) de la Facultad de Ciencias de la Ingeniería UACh. 
Actualmente (2023) se encuentra financiado por el [Proyecto de Conservación Habitable Isla San Francisco](https://islasanfrancisco.cl/), con aportes de [Cerveza Kunstmann](https://cerveza-kunstmann.cl/).

No dudes en contactarnos para más información, cotizar, establecer sinergias estratégicas, colaborar o aportar monetaria o intelectualmente para que Humedat@ continúe creciendo y aportando información clave para la conservación de humedales. 

**Versión beta**: vandrán muchas actualizaciones cosméticas y analíticas, incluyendo un número de ajustes/correcciones de parámetros de calidad de agua.   

[Centro de Humedales Río Cruces](https://cehum.org/)  

contacto@cehum.org

panels.description: Esto es para estudiar frecuencia de flujo de datos. Internamente Humedat@ registra mediaciones regularmente (actualmente programado cada 15 min).

targets.rawSql:
-- SQL Script for Grafana Dashboard to Monitor Time Elapsed Between Data Packages Reception

SELECT
  DATE_SUB(a.timestamp, INTERVAL 0 HOUR) AS "time",
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, b.timestamp, a.timestamp) AS "time_elapsed_in_minutes"
FROM
  (SELECT *, @row_number_a:=@row_number_a + 1 AS rn FROM logs, (SELECT @row_number_a:=0) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '1' ORDER BY timestamp) a
JOIN
  (SELECT *, @row_number_b:=@row_number_b + 1 AS rn FROM logs, (SELECT @row_number_b:=0) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = '1' ORDER BY timestamp) b
ON
  a.rn = b.rn + 1
ORDER BY
  a.timestamp;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  atmospheric_pressure AS `Presión Atmosférica`
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  atmospheric_temperature AS `Temperatura Atmosférica`,
  internal_temperature AS `Temperatura Interna`,
  water_temperature AS `Temperatura del Agua`
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  dissolved_oxygen AS `Raw DO`,
  do_15 AS 'DO at 15°C',
  do_temp AS 'DO at Current T°'
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  sat AS `RAW SAT`,
  sat_temp AS 'SAT at Current T°'
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  oxide_reduction_potential AS `Potencial de Reduccción`
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  electrical_conductivity AS `RAW EC`,
  ec_temp AS 'EC at Current T°'
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  total_dissolved_solids
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  ph AS 'pH',
  ph_temp 'pH at Current T°'
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND
  dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  battery_level
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  #timestamp AS "time",
  DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS "time",# This is a offset to account for daylight saving time. 
  internal_humidity AS `Humedad Interna`
FROM logs
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND dev_id = 1
ORDER BY timestamp
